data.name: Silence Archives Terminal
data.detailed_description:
A signal that shouldn't exist. An archive that was never meant to be found.

You are an operator assigned to investigate the Silence Archives — a classified repository of 120 intercepted documents, internal reports, and encrypted communications. Your terminal is your only interface. Your commands are your only weapons.

Somewhere in the noise, a 47Hz signal anomaly pulses. The deeper you dig, the more the Federation notices.

OBSERVE. BUT KNOW THAT OBSERVATION CHANGES EVERYTHING.

Every archive you read shifts the σ (sigma) curvature index — a quantum-inspired metric that tracks how far your investigation has altered the trajectory of events. Once it crosses the irreversible threshold, there is no going back. You

are no longer just the observer. You are part of the signal.

CORE MECHANICS

- Terminal Interface — No menus, no maps. Type commands into a CRT-style terminal. Search, open, analyze, decode.

- σ Curvature System — Your reading choices accumulate into an irreversible metric. Three phases: Reversible → Critical → Irreversible. Every file tips the balance.

- Clearance Levels — Start at LEVEL 0. As you uncover cross-references and decrypt Valis ciphers, your clearance rises through 6 tiers up to OMEGA — unlocking classified "B-side" documents hidden beneath the surface.

- Federation Threat Clock — The Silicon Federation monitors your activity. Suspicious searches, unauthorized access attempts, and erratic behavior raise your threat level. Push too hard, and the system pushes back.

- Valis Encryption — Hidden annotations in select archives contain encrypted messages. Crack the ciphers to access deeper truths.

- Conspiracy Board — Pin entities, draw connections, trace hidden relationships across the archive. The red strings reveal what the documents alone cannot.

THREE ENDINGS. YOUR INVESTIGATION STYLE DECIDES.

Your path through the archives shapes which ending you reach:

- The Standard Report — A balanced investigation. Methodical. Thorough. The "official" conclusion.

- The Paranoid Dossier — Obsessive cross-referencing. Trust nothing. See patterns everywhere.

- The Distorted Signal — Maximum σ curvature. You didn't just observe the signal — you became it.

THE FEDERATION IS ALWAYS WATCHING

[SIGMA CORE] ██ IRREVERSIBLE THRESHOLD BREACHED ██ Observation has collapsed the wave function σ >= 0.081 — one-way trajectory locked ▓▓▓ you are both the observer and the observed ▓▓▓

FEATURES

- 120 classified archive documents with layered narrative

- Retro CRT terminal with authentic scan-line effects

- σ curvature system — irreversible player-driven consequence

- 6 clearance tiers with hidden "B-side" content

- Valis cipher puzzles embedded within archives

- Conspiracy board with entity connections and breakthroughs

- Federation threat clock with immersive system overrides

- 25 Steam achievements tracking investigation milestones

- Steam Cloud save — continue your investigation across devices

- Full gamepad support with Steam Deck verified compatibility

- AI-powered archive generation — create new classified documents (optional, requires API key)

- Eleven languages: English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, Deutsch, Español, Español (Latinoamérica), Français, Italiano, Português, Português (Brasil)

PART OF THE SILENCE PROTOCOL UNIVERSE

Silence Archives Terminal is a companion experience to The Silence Protocol trilogy. The 120 archives contain fragments of a larger story — but the terminal stands alone as a complete investigation.

The silence is not empty. It is full of answers.

data.short_description: Hack into a classified archive of 120 intercepted documents. In this retro terminal investigation, every file you read alters reality — your observations are irreversible, the Federation is watching, and three divergent endings await based on how deep you dare to dig.

pc_requirements.minimum:
최소:
  • 운영 체제: Windows 10 64-bit
  • 프로세서: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 (Dual-core 1.5 GHz)
  • 메모리: 2 GB RAM
  • 그래픽: Integrated GPU with WebGL support
  • 저장 공간: 300 MB 사용 가능 공간
pc_requirements.recommended:
권장:
  • 운영 체제: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • 프로세서: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • 메모리: 4 GB RAM
  • 그래픽: WebGL 2.0 GPU
  • 저장 공간: 500 MB 사용 가능 공간

mac_requirements.minimum:
최소:
  • Apple 프로세서 필요
  • 운영 체제: macOS 10.15 (Catalina)
  • 프로세서: Intel Core i3 / Apple M1
  • 메모리: 2 GB RAM
  • 그래픽: Integrated GPU with Metal support
mac_requirements.recommended:
권장:
  • Apple 프로세서 필요
  • 운영 체제: macOS 13 (Ventura) or Higher
  • 프로세서: Apple M1 or Higher
  • 메모리: 4 GB RAM
  • 그래픽: Apple Silicon GPU
  • 저장 공간: 500 MB 사용 가능 공간

linux_requirements.minimum:
최소:
  • 운영 체제: Ubuntu 20.04 / SteamOS 3.0
  • 프로세서: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 (Dual-core 1.5 GHz)
  • 메모리: 2 GB RAM
  • 그래픽: OpenGL 3.2+ support
  • 저장 공간: 300 MB 사용 가능 공간
linux_requirements.recommended:
권장:
  • 운영 체제: Ubuntu 22.04 / SteamOS 3.5
  • 프로세서: 4-Cores 2.0 GHz
  • 메모리: 4 GB RAM
  • 그래픽: 支持 Vulkan
  • 저장 공간: 500 MB 사용 가능 공간
